prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished logo concept presentation for Manor, a personal productivity web app for notes, tasks, habits, daily reflection, and knowledge. Calm, refined, intuitive digital product identity. Flat, vector-friendly solid geometry with beautifully balanced negative space, recognizable at favicon size. No mascots, characters, paper grain, handwriting, 3D, gradients, shadows, sparkles, stock productivity checkmarks, or real-estate advertising aesthetic. Palette: deep plum #76508C, near-neutral charcoal #29262D, white, and pale lavender #C5A3DD for dark mode. Wordmark exact text 'Manor', set in Outfit or an extremely close geometric sans-serif, medium weight, carefully spaced. Presentation: landscape identity card, large generous upper white area with main horizontal symbol-and-wordmark lockup. Lower third contains two equal clean light and charcoal panels showing smaller standalone versions of EXACTLY the same symbol, with no app-icon rounded-square enclosure. Keep consistent geometry in all three uses. Small upper-left concept number and name in neutral sans. No other text. This is a logo exploration, not a UI screen or poster. Concept label: '01 / Threshold'. Direction: A distinctive abstract doorway or open arch. Build a single thick architectural arch with a subtle off-center opening/cut that suggests an inviting entrance and an M without literal house roof, windows, stairs, or building illustration. Quiet, confident and exceptionally simple.
